- Flory's 1941 gel point, the condition alpha(f-1) = 1, and alpha_c = 1/(f-1) giving 1/2 and 1/3 <sub>(014)</sub>

- Kermack and McKendrick's 1927 threshold density and the overshoot remark <sub>(014)</sub>
